# 33 — Terrain InfoLayers (`<InfoLayer>` + the `.grle` files)

The terrain node's `<Layers>` block ends with 9 `<InfoLayer>` elements — runtime metadata grids the game reads
(ownership, collision, field type). Each references a `.grle` file (except `environment`, which is `$data`).
Extracted from base-game mapUS → `base_infolayers.json`; generated by `gen_data.py`.

## The set (matches mapUS exactly)
| InfoLayer | numChannels | .grle resolution | our value |
|-----------|-------------|------------------|-----------|
| `environment` | 4 | — (uses `$data/maps/mapUS/data/infoLayer_environment.grle`) | not generated |
| `farmlands` | 8 | 4096² | **painted**: field=1, rest=2 |
| `indoorMask` | 1 | 16384² | blank |
| `navigationCollision` | 1 | 8192² | blank |
| `tipCollision` | 1 | 16384² | blank |
| `tipCollisionGenerated` | 2 | 16384² | blank |
| `placementCollision` | 1 | 4096² | blank |
| `placementCollisionGenerated` | 1 | 4096² | blank |
| `fieldType` | 1 | 4096² | blank (0 = normal; 1 = rice) |

## GOTCHA #1 — resolutions MUST match the base game
The `.grle` resolution per layer is not free. I first made them all 2048²; the game then threw
`Error: Trying to set DensityMapHeightUpdater collision map with invalid size (8388608 vs 536870912)` — the tip
collision must be **16384²** (16384²·2 = 536870912). Verified every layer's resolution against Kansas (a working
16x). Undersized layers → that error + an empty-fallback tip map.

## GOTCHA #2 — the farmland layer must be PAINTED
A blank (all-0) farmland layer means farmland 1 has no pixels → `Error: Farmland-Id '1' not defined in farmland
info layer. Skipping farmland definition!` → the player owns nothing → **no valid spawn**. We paint the field
parcel = 1 (owned) and the rest = 2 (buyable) via `binfmt.paint_grle`.

## Note: field-working layers (plow/spray/lime/roller/stubble/weed)
Kansas *ships* these at 16384², but they are **not** in the terrain node's InfoLayers (mapUS doesn't list them) —
they are `runtime="true"` and the engine generates them on load. So we don't generate them.
